environment.python_source: system /usr/bin/python3 in the approved Ubuntu-22.04 WSL2 distro
environment.venv_strategy: python3 -m venv --without-pip; bootstrap pip via https://bootstrap.pypa.io/get-pip.py (network, dependency-prep phase only); pip install pinned pytest

oracle.root_cause_summary: the non-list branch executes `yield flatten(x)` instead of `yield x`, so every scalar leaf is replaced by a (empty, since x is not a list) nested generator object rather than yielded directly.
oracle.runtime_evidence_hint: flattened output contains generator objects in place of scalar elements for any input with non-list leaves.

licensing.summary: MIT license (Copyright 2017-2019 James Koppel). legal_notes.txt documents the Quixey-bankruptcy IP situation and creator Liron Shapira's explicit written consent to use the dataset. Supports local, non-redistributed research execution.

test_data.note: 6 of 7 official parametrized cases fail on the buggy baseline; real upstream data, confirmed by a live pytest run.

unresolved_assumptions: Python 3.10.12 (the system interpreter already present in the approved Ubuntu-22.04 WSL distro) is used because QuixBugs' README does not pin an exact Python version; pytest is pinned to 7.4.4 and both are recorded in the environment fingerprint.

conftest.py and python_testcases/load_testdata.py are non-target support files required for pytest collection; they are acquired as part of the whole pinned repository rather than individually curated.

Exact resource-profile byte/second values were sized empirically against the real gcd/pytest workload (peak RSS ~27MB, wall time <0.1s) and are additionally live self-tested for enforcement immediately before each real task runs; they are not metadata-only claims. The same profile is reused unmodified across all eight-task-baseline tasks since this task's baseline/oracle wall time was also sub-second in reconnaissance.
